sentences.text: None for the petitioners.

Shri Rohit Jain - Government Advocate for respondent no
Shri Siddharth Sharma - Advocate for respondent no. 2.

This petition is filed being aggrieved of the act of the respondents in carrying out pipelines for supply of water in rural areas through project known as Satna Bansagar Multi Village Rural Water Supply.

entities.text: Satna Bansagar Multi Village Rural Water Supply
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: It is alleged that without publishing any notice and without giving opportunity of hearing to the petitioners, the land has been dugged up for water project and pipelines have been made on their land.
It is submitted that the Madhya Pradesh Bhumigat Pipe Line Cable Evam Duct (Bhumi Ki Upyokta Ke Adhikaron Ka Arjan) Adhiniyam 2012 has not been followed and no compensation has been paid.

entities.text: Madhya Pradesh Bhumigat Pipe Line Cable Evam Duct (Bhumi Ki Upyokta Ke Adhikaron Ka Arjan)
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Shri Siddharth Sharma, learned counsel and Shri Rohit Jain, learned Government Advocate in their turn submits that they have filed the reply.
The provisions of the Act of 2012 are not applicable.
In terms of the provisions contained in Section 57 of the Madhya Pradesh Land Revenue Code, 1959 and all the rights in the subsoil of any land are the property of the State Government.
It is submitted that no commercial activity is being carried out in supplying water to the rural operation and, therefore, the provisions of the Act of 2012 are not applicable.
It is submitted that the pipeline is being dugged up below one meter.

There is an undertaking that the pressurized pipeline will be placed atleast one meter under the ground and, therefore, the land will be impacted only for a brief period during which the pipeline is being laid.

sentences.text: At this stage, on a perusal of the Act of 2012, it appears that as per Section 3, there has to be publication of notification for acquisition of right of user.
No notification is brought on record either by the respondent no. 2 or by the State Government.

Let an affidavit of respondent no. 2 and the Collector concerned be filed to demonstrate that as to when notification under Section 3 of the Act of 2012 was issued, though Shri Rohit Jain submits that they have invoked provisions contained in Section 57.
The State Government is required to show that under which provision of law, this work has been outsourced to respondent nos. 2 and 3.
Let a specific reply be filed by respondent nos. 2 and 4 in this behalf.
List this case in the week commencing 25 th September, 2023.
